* 2.5 million [[Florida]] residents are ordered to evacuate their homes in preparation for [[Hurricane Frances]], which has already hit the [[Bahamas]] and [[Turks and Caicos Islands]]. Frances is currently a strong [[Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale|Category Two Hurricane]], and will be very near the east coast of Florida by late tonight or early next morning. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/americas/3625252.stm (BBC)] [http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/ (NOAA/NHC)]
* ''[[The X Factor]]'' makes its worldwide debut premiering for the first time in the UK and will later go on to become the biggest show in television history.
*In [[American football]], [[Bellevue High School (Bellevue, Washington)|Bellevue]] defeats [[De La Salle High School (Concord, California)|De La Salle]] with a score of 39-20, ending De La Salle's 151-winning streak, which was the longest in [[high school football]]. [https://www.seattlepi.com/news/article/Bellevue-ends-De-LaSalle-s-151-game-streak-1153417.php (''Seattle Post-Intelligencer'')]
*In AFL Essendon Bombers won their most recent final against Melbourne Demons with a score of 104-99
